configuration._note: redaction.DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH is relative, so face redaction is on or off depending on the cwd this process was launched from, and the two produce materially different reconstructions. A comparison between runs with different redaction_available is not a comparison.

reprojection._note: recomputed by re-detecting ORB and re-projecting; the pipeline persists no residual. The 3 px bar is enforced on source views only, so fraction_over_3px is the ungated tail, not a violation count.
